# Commands

Every command of brig, as [`brig`](brig.md) lists them. Run `brig COMMAND --help` for the same text in a terminal, or `man brig-COMMAND`.

## VM commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`brig agent`](brig-agent.md) | Set up a coding agent's image, provider and template, rebuild its image and move its sandboxes to it |
| [`brig agent build`](brig-agent-build.md) | Rebuild an agent's image, copy it into a VM and point its template at it |
| [`brig agent init`](brig-agent-init.md) | Write the files for a first agent sandbox, and with --vm set it up |
| [`brig agent update`](brig-agent-update.md) | Move an agent's sandboxes to its current image, keeping their /sandbox |
| [`brig audit`](brig-audit.md) | Show what sandboxes reached, and who allowed it |
| [`brig audit prune`](brig-audit-prune.md) | Delete audit history |
| [`brig audit status`](brig-audit-status.md) | Show the audit collectors and the space their history takes |
| [`brig console`](brig-console.md) | Attach to a VM's serial console (exit with Ctrl+]) |
| [`brig create`](brig-create.md) | Create and start a VM |
| [`brig delete`](brig-delete.md) | Delete a VM and all its data |
| [`brig env`](brig-env.md) | Print shell commands that point the openshell CLI at a VM |
| [`brig list`](brig-list.md) | List VMs |
| [`brig policy`](brig-policy.md) | Compare sandbox policies with the policy files in the config directories, and save rules to them |
| [`brig policy allow`](brig-policy-allow.md) | Let a sandbox's program reach a host, and keep the rule for new sandboxes |
| [`brig policy diff`](brig-policy-diff.md) | Show how a sandbox's network rules differ from its policy file |
| [`brig policy save`](brig-policy-save.md) | Write rules added to a sandbox into its policy file |
| [`brig sandbox`](brig-sandbox.md) | Create, list and work in OpenShell sandboxes |
| [`brig sandbox attach`](brig-sandbox-attach.md) | Attach a provider to a sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox clean`](brig-sandbox-clean.md) | Delete the expired sandboxes that brig sandbox run left |
| [`brig sandbox connect`](brig-sandbox-connect.md) | Open a terminal in a sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox create`](brig-sandbox-create.md) | Create an OpenShell sandbox in a VM, with host directories mounted read-only |
| [`brig sandbox delete`](brig-sandbox-delete.md) | Delete a sandbox and its /sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox detach`](brig-sandbox-detach.md) | Detach a provider from a sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox exec`](brig-sandbox-exec.md) | Run a command in a sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox list`](brig-sandbox-list.md) | List the sandboxes of a VM, or of every running VM |
| [`brig sandbox logs`](brig-sandbox-logs.md) | Show a sandbox's logs, such as the requests its policy denied |
| [`brig sandbox recreate`](brig-sandbox-recreate.md) | Move a sandbox to a new image, keeping its /sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox run`](brig-sandbox-run.md) | Run a command in a new sandbox, with files in and out, and delete it |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot`](brig-sandbox-snapshot.md) | Keep copies of a sandbox's /sandbox in its VM, and bring them back |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot create`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-create.md) | Take a snapshot of a sandbox's /sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot delete`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-delete.md) | Delete snapshots |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot list`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-list.md) | List the snapshots in a VM, with the space they take |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot prune`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-prune.md) | Delete the snapshots of deleted sandboxes and old snapshots |
| [`brig sandbox snapshot restore`](brig-sandbox-snapshot-restore.md) | Replace a sandbox's /sandbox with a snapshot |
| [`brig sandbox start`](brig-sandbox-start.md) | Start a stopped sandbox |
| [`brig sandbox stop`](brig-sandbox-stop.md) | Stop a sandbox, keeping its /sandbox |
| [`brig secret`](brig-secret.md) | Store the secrets that providers in the config directories refer to |
| [`brig secret list`](brig-secret-list.md) | Show which providers' secrets are stored, never their values |
| [`brig secret set`](brig-secret-set.md) | Store the secret of a provider's credential in the keyring |
| [`brig service`](brig-service.md) | Run services that sandboxes use, each with a token of its own |
| [`brig service attach`](brig-service-attach.md) | Give a sandbox a token for a service |
| [`brig service create`](brig-service-create.md) | Create and start a service |
| [`brig service delete`](brig-service-delete.md) | Delete a service, its VM and its tokens |
| [`brig service detach`](brig-service-detach.md) | Take a sandbox's token for a service away |
| [`brig service list`](brig-service-list.md) | List services |
| [`brig service show`](brig-service-show.md) | Show a service and the sandboxes attached to it |
| [`brig service start`](brig-service-start.md) | Start a service |
| [`brig service stop`](brig-service-stop.md) | Stop a service |
| [`brig service types`](brig-service-types.md) | List the service types that this brig has |
| [`brig show`](brig-show.md) | Show a VM's settings and state |
| [`brig ssh`](brig-ssh.md) | Open a shell in a VM, or run a command there |
| [`brig start`](brig-start.md) | Start a VM and connect its OpenShell gateway |
| [`brig stop`](brig-stop.md) | Shut a VM down |
| [`brig sync`](brig-sync.md) | Apply a VM's OpenShell config directories to its gateway |
| [`brig up`](brig-up.md) | Make a VM ready to work in, and list its sandboxes |
| [`brig update`](brig-update.md) | Change a VM's resources, mounts, network profile or OpenShell config directories |
| [`brig upgrade`](brig-upgrade.md) | Move a VM onto a newer base image, keeping its data |
| [`brig use`](brig-use.md) | Point the openshell CLI in this shell at a VM, or show which one |

## Host commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`brig doctor`](brig-doctor.md) | Check whether this host can build images and run VMs |
| [`brig image`](brig-image.md) | Manage base images and container images in VMs |
| [`brig image build`](brig-image-build.md) | Build a base image with mkosi |
| [`brig image list`](brig-image-list.md) | List base images, newest first |
| [`brig image prune`](brig-image-prune.md) | Remove base images except the newest and those in use, and mkosi's package cache |
| [`brig image push`](brig-image-push.md) | Copy a container image from the host's Podman into a VM |
| [`brig image rm`](brig-image-rm.md) | Remove base images that no VM uses |
| [`brig print-fedora-deps`](brig-print-fedora-deps.md) | Print the Fedora packages brig needs on this host |
| [`brig ui`](brig-ui.md) | Open a local web UI for brig's VMs |

## Other commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`brig completion`](brig-completion.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell |
| [`brig completion bash`](brig-completion-bash.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for bash |
| [`brig completion fish`](brig-completion-fish.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for fish |
| [`brig completion powershell`](brig-completion-powershell.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for powershell |
| [`brig completion zsh`](brig-completion-zsh.md) | Generate the autocompletion script for zsh |
| [`brig shell-init`](brig-shell-init.md) | Print the shell integration that provides brig use |
| [`brig version`](brig-version.md) | Print the brig version |

The concepts and how-tos that `brig help TOPIC` explains are in the [glossary](../glossary.md).
